verdict.rationale: GitBook advertises 'Analytics & user feedback' and an 'AI insights' analytics page, suggesting page views, feedback and search insight tracking, but there's no documented evidence of search-term analytics specifically. A hands-on community report explicitly contradicts the accuracy of GitBook's traffic analytics ('traffic stats are not realistic, counts page loads, off by 2-3x vs Google Analytics, country demographics clearly wrong'), directly undercutting the 'know which docs work' claim. missing for 10: dedicated search-term analytics evidence, recent corroboration of analytics accuracy, first-party detail on reader feedback mechanisms.
